CHROMIUM: media: rk3288-vpu: Do not fail on invalid format VIDIOC_S_FMT is defined to adjust the format to a valid one, if invalid one is given by the client. Follow the specification rather than returning error. BUG=chromium:873939 TEST=test_that video_Video{Decode,Encode}Accelerator Change-Id: If8a339fe07c8b33e9fc835f7d7025d7a490be91f Signed-off-by: Tomasz Figa <tfiga@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1173950 Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Alexandre Courbot <acourbot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hirokazu Honda <hiroh@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: media: rk3288-vpu: Fix plane size calculation Both encoder and decoder reimplement the same calculations, with slightly different assumptions (MPLANE format for encoder vs non-MPLANE format for decoder) and with the same problems that sometimes even result in the values not being computed correctly: - total bytesperline returned for single memory plane formats, rather than just the value of the first color plane, - the depth (bits per pixel) values in the format arrays do not match the real values of the formats, - there is a shady assumption that all formats with more than 1 memory plane are always vertically subsampled by 2. Differentiate between number of color planes and memory planes, add subsampling factors to the rk3288_vpu_fmt struct and use that to generalize the calculations into a common helper. BUG=chromium:873939 TEST=test_that video_Video{Decode,Encode}Accelerator Change-Id: I4258850ae57bf31058ffbbd3f0e27ebac4280955 Signed-off-by: Tomasz Figa <tfiga@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1174071 Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Alexandre Courbot <acourbot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hirokazu Honda <hiroh@chromium.org>
